description: This is a unit test class named 'ValidationDecoratorTest' designed to test the functionality of the 'ValidationDecorator' component within the OrangeHRM project. The class contains test methods that validate parameter validation logic, including both successful validation and exception handling scenarios.

classes.name: ValidationDecoratorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit-based test class for testing the ValidationDecorator's validation logic, including handling of valid data and exceptions.

methods.name: testValidationDecorator
methods.description: Tests that valid input values pass validation successfully.

methods.name: validationDecoratorDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various sets of valid test data and corresponding rules for validation.

methods.name: testValidationDecoratorWithException
methods.description: Tests that invalid input values correctly trigger validation exceptions.

methods.name: validationDecoratorWithExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data that should fail validation, triggering exceptions.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of ValidationDecorator for use in tests.
